title: Custom APIRoute classes with explicit constructors fail after strict_content_type was added
author: 4x4550x
body_preview: ### Summary  Recent FastAPI versions added `strict_content_type` and now pass it through `APIRouter.add_api_route()` into the configured `route_class`. This breaks custom `APIRoute` subclasses that define an explicit constructor matching the previous public `APIRoute.__init__` signature.
